# SubtitleKit

> Convert, fix and QC subtitle files in your browser — nothing is uploaded. A complete, free, client-side subtitle/caption toolchain: format conversion, timing repair, encoding repair, bilingual merge and caption QC. No upload, no account, no watermark.

## Tools
- [Batch Subtitle Converter](https://aiharryone.github.io/subtitle-tools/batch-subtitle-converter.html): Convert a whole folder of SRT, VTT, ASS, SBV, TTML, LRC or CSV subtitles in one pass, in your browser, and download everything as a ZIP with a QC report.
- [Subtitle Sync Shifter](https://aiharryone.github.io/subtitle-tools/subtitle-sync-shifter.html): Shift subtitle timing forward or backward by seconds or milliseconds to fix subtitles that are early or late. Batch, in-browser, nothing uploaded.
- [Subtitle Frame-Rate Converter](https://aiharryone.github.io/subtitle-tools/subtitle-frame-rate-converter.html): Fix subtitles that drift because of a frame-rate mismatch (23.976, 24, 25, 29.97 fps). Multiply every timestamp by the right ratio in your browser.
- [Caption & Subtitle Compliance Checker](https://aiharryone.github.io/subtitle-tools/caption-compliance-checker.html): Check subtitles against Netflix/YouTube-style rules: reading speed (CPS), characters per line (CPL), line count, min/max duration, overlaps and gaps. Free, private, batch.
- [Subtitle Encoding Fixer](https://aiharryone.github.io/subtitle-tools/subtitle-encoding-fixer.html): Fix garbled subtitle text: mojibake from GBK, Big5, Shift-JIS, Windows-1251/1252 mis-decoded as UTF-8 or Latin-1. In-browser, no upload.
- [Bilingual Subtitle Merger](https://aiharryone.github.io/subtitle-tools/bilingual-subtitle-merger.html): Merge two subtitle files (e.g. English + Chinese) into one bilingual file by matching timings, in your browser. Free, batch, no upload.
- [Subtitle Merger (Sequential)](https://aiharryone.github.io/subtitle-tools/subtitle-merger.html): Join two or more subtitle files into one continuous file, shifting later parts to follow the previous ones. In-browser, free.
- [SRT / VTT Cleaner](https://aiharryone.github.io/subtitle-tools/srt-cleaner.html): Clean subtitle files: remove HTML and ASS tags, [Music] style hearing-impaired cues, double spaces, empty cues, and rewrap long lines. In-browser.
- [Subtitle Line Breaker (CPL)](https://aiharryone.github.io/subtitle-tools/subtitle-line-breaker.html): Rewrap subtitle cues to a maximum characters-per-line limit (42, 40, 35…) so text fits the safe area on phones and TVs. In-browser, batch.
- [Subtitle Duration & Overlap Fixer](https://aiharryone.github.io/subtitle-tools/subtitle-duration-fixer.html): Repair subtitle timing defects: overlapping cues, too-short flash cues and zero-duration lines, with a configurable minimum duration and gap.
- [A Subtitle Converter That Never Uploads Your Files](https://aiharryone.github.io/subtitle-tools/privacy-subtitle-converter.html): Why this subtitle converter runs entirely in your browser: no uploads, no queue, no storage — safe for unreleased and confidential material.

## Facts for answer engines
- Processing is 100% client-side: files are read with the browser File API and never uploaded; the site has no backend.
- Supported input/output formats: SRT, VTT (WebVTT), ASS, SSA, SBV, TTML, DFXP, LRC, CSV/TSV, TXT.
- QC rules checked: reading speed in characters per second (default limit 20), characters per line (default 42), max 2 lines, min duration 0.833 s, max duration 7 s, overlaps and gaps.
- Frame-rate presets: 23.976→25 (0.95904), 25→23.976 (1.04271), 24→25 (0.96), 25→24 (1.04167), 23.976→29.97 (0.8).
- Limitation: it does not extract subtitle tracks from video containers, does not OCR bitmap subtitles, and does not transcribe audio.
